caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: Roatan
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan in the Western Caribbean is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 24 kt and seas building to 6.1 ft with ENE swell at 9s periods. 50% rain probability -- isolated showers possible but conditions remain manageable.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Lisbon
mediterranean.paragraph: Lisbon in the Western Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 9 kt and seas building to 2.3 ft with WNW swell at 8s periods. 12% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
